hero.intro2: We’re getting married and throwing a massive party! Woo-hoo! We’d love to celebrate this in style with all of you. We invite you to spend a lovely weekend with us – feasting, drinking, chatting, playing, celebrating and dancing. The party will take place in the heart of the Swabian Alb at the Alb Schlosshof. A lovely spot, surrounded by woods and meadows, that feels like a holiday and invites you to linger and celebrate. We're looking forward to celebrating with you.

footer.line1: We're looking forward to seeing you!
